# YXO (Young Extraordinary Odyssey)

> YXO runs full-day, in-person workshops that teach teens ages 13 to 17 to think bigger, use AI as a tool for their own ideas, and start building a personal roadmap for an extraordinary life. Website: https://yxo.world

## Upcoming workshops

- Miami, FL: the YXO Miami cohort starts Saturday, November 7, 2026. $300 for one student, $500 for two. Register at https://yxo.world/#register

## What teens leave with

- AI fluency
- An entrepreneurial mindset
- A personal roadmap
- A certificate of completion

## How the day works

Methods borrowed from psychology, theatre, improv, and play: icebreakers, mindset shifts, a resilience lab, a crazy ideas brainstorm, hands-on building with AI, understanding world problems, using the device as a tool for creation, starting a company versus working for others, an Extraordinary Life Workshop, and a wrap-up with certificates. Teens bring a laptop and charger. The workshop is teens only; drop-off is at 10 AM and pickup at 4 PM.

## People

- Lily Safrani: founder of YXO.
- Natasha Tsakos: workshop mentor. Award-winning director, performer, and producer working at the intersection of arts, technology, innovation, and space exploration. Founder of SPACE WONDERS. TEDx talk: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nEmjcz5LS-o
- Workshops are led by Singularity University alumni.
- Team page: https://yxo.world/team
